OperatorNotificationReadRequest.description: Unknown fields are rejected. Content-Type must start with application/json; one complete JSON document, at most 16384 request bytes. Version compare-and-swap. Missing, null, zero or negative expected_version fails semantic validation with VALIDATION_FAILED (400); a non-integer or overflowing int64 fails decoding with VALIDATION_ERROR (400). A positive expected_version that does not match the persisted version, or a missing notification resource, yields VERSION_CONFLICT (409). No Idempotency-Key is used.

OperatorConversationErrorEnvelope.description: Two real error writers: handler/operatorDecode emit only error.code; store/domain failures use thWriteError with full ErrorEnvelope and meta. Decode uses VALIDATION_ERROR while semantic validation uses VALIDATION_FAILED. HTTP 400/401/403/404/405/409/415/500/503 depend on the actual source; no generic success data.
